decisions.reason: Because it remained on the website through 2024 in a growing market, management would likely see performance as at least near aspiration, although overlap with other express offers leaves some consolidation risk.

The 72-hour program still signals enough demand to stay, but its likely higher operating strain and narrow use case make it the most vulnerable of the surviving offers if results fall short of aspiration.
Its own dedicated page in both years and fit with the firm's service-and-speed positioning suggest results above aspiration and strong use of existing production and logistics resources.
As a strategic digital layer on the core business, it likely benefits from organizational slack and long-term learning value even if direct short-run returns are still maturing.
Its move from a simple mention to a dedicated page by 2024 indicates performance comfortably above aspiration and strong alignment with the firm's safety-compliance strengths.
